scope: frozen W07 task gates and A05 contract
public adapter implementations and cursor persistence
two existing live evidence sets inspected offline
bounded in-memory response probes on isolated exact Git snapshot
constraints: no external service, browser, or credential access
product source and existing receipts unchanged
no PDF or redirect regression repetition

findings.finding: The assertion checks only X UNVERIFIED state and a nonempty GitHub item list; x_primary_context_url is not a claim-to-primary-source verification.
findings.observed_existing_evidence: The X item claims Paperclip gained 2,251 stars in one day with 93,960 total. The GitHub item is v2026.916.1 release notes about message send-button and duplicate-insert fixes. X remains CONTEXT/UNVERIFIED with origin_evidence_id=null. Shared project topic does not substantiate those numeric claims.
findings.minimum_closure: Bind at least one specific claim from an actual X snapshot to a relevant actual primary snapshot/version and locator, record supported/unsupported findings, and assert the binding plus non-adoption of unsupported claims. Separate requested/observed windows must remain explicit.

findings.input: An in-memory 100-release dataset: capture page=1 with limit=1, persist opaque_cursor=2, then capture page=2 with limit=100.
findings.observed: Second page is empty and Complete=true. Actual HTTP advanceSourceCursor returns 200 and covered_until=2026-09-29T00:00:00Z while only 1 Evidence exists; 99 releases were skipped.
findings.minimum_closure: Bind the page size to the persisted continuation/query window or encode it into opaque continuation and reject incompatible resumption. Preserve provider cursor consistency.

findings.input: HTTP 200 with GitHub body null, and HTTP 200 with arXiv body <html><body>upstream temporarily unavailable</body></html>.
findings.observed: Both return Complete=true, Failure empty, zero items and nil error. Valid GitHub [] and Atom empty-feed positive controls also succeed.
findings.minimum_closure: Validate the expected top-level response shape and sufficient empty-result metadata before treating a response as valid empty coverage.

findings.input: Actual GitHub adapter with in-memory transport returning HTTP 429 and Retry-After:60. Two successive product sourceConfig/captureSourcePage calls.
findings.observed: Both calls see stored retry_after=null and make provider requests, about 17ms apart. Both correctly return RATE_LIMITED plus future RetryAfter, but the second request violates the returned wait. Existing test manually seeds retry_after via PUT before capture.
findings.minimum_closure: Persist the provider wait into current source state on the actual capture failure path (or supply and exercise an equivalent integrated caller), then prove a second call does not fetch until the wait expires.

positive_bounded_observations: Existing failed run remains failed; its GitHub and PAPER item hashes match snapshots. Existing successful run has matching body/raw/manifest hashes for all three source kinds.

Source capture reauthenticates the current principal and rechecks the complete enabled source config hash before committing snapshots; this is a static observation, not an executed permission-change regression.
X UI observations remain non-exhaustive and do not produce durable complete page checkpoints.
Previously independently closed invalid-PDF and redirect regressions were not reopened or rerun.
raw_log_integrity: Original stdout and stderr are retained; no reconstructed stdout is used. Original first probe bytes retained separately after adding the retry probe.
